items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Beale and I swapped jobs and it was okay with Jimmie and it was okay with Armstrong. So Charlie Beale went with Armstrong, and I went with Jimmie Noone

ctx.x: We went down -- we toured down in Texas, in Arkansas, Oklahoma and Nebraska, Louisiana, Mississippi -- and Indiana. That whole area south and west of Chicago. And let's see, I got in contact with Charlie Beale.
